messages:
rachel: Kicking off staged rollout: deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-20. Target 20% overall — split policy: us-west 20%, eu-west 0%, ap-south 5% (stepped). Change window 20:00-21:00 UTC. Dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-20 :rocket; logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-20

deploy-bot: deploy started at 20:01 UTC. Strategy: regional split. Phases: us-west -> ap-south. Auto-lift disabled for eu-west. To take actions: `/deploy action <pause|rollback --to <tag>|pin --version <tag>|reroute --region <r> --pct <n>`

diego: saw a small 502 cluster in eu-edge at 20:05 even though eu-west was set to 0% — looks like shared infra path hit. 502s concentrated on session-router. Dash snippet: https://dash.re/metrics/session-router

lee: confirming: edge proxies for eu0 share the same regional cache nodes as us-west; when us-west traffic increased cache pressure propagated to eu-edge. Session-router 502s correlate with kcache_miss spikes.

rachel: hold lifts to ap-south. Do we want to reroute eu-bound clients to the fallback model (v2.3.1) rather than rollback globally? That would be lighter.

diego: vote: reroute eu-edge -> v2.3.1 at 100% for now, keep us-west on the new build. Minimizes customer impact.

lee: vote: reroute + pin eu fallback. Also open incident so SRE can tune cache isolation.

ops: creating INC-2026-144 for regional cache pressure + session-router 502s. Assigning to @lee and @sanjay for cache isolation.

rachel: executing reroute: `/deploy reroute --region eu-west --to-version v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-20 --reason "eu-edge 502s due to shared cache pressure"`

deploy-bot: reroute executed. eu-west traffic now served by v2.3.1. Rolling back regional traffic only. Monitoring.

diego: immediate drop in 502s on eu-edge, p95 latency recovering. Nice.

lee: infra notes: cache eviction rate on shared nodes down from 150/min -> 8/min since reroute. We'll snapshot heap profiles and propose node affinity for eu.

rachel: pin eu-west to v2.3.1 for the remainder of window: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --region eu-west --until 2026-03-23T21:00:00Z`

deploy-bot: pinned v2.3.1 for eu-west until 2026-03-23T21:00:00Z. Incident INC-2026-144 linked to the deploy.

diego: preparing a short release-note amendment: "Partial regional rollback: eu-west routed to v2.3.1 due to shared cache pressure affecting session-router 502s; investigating cache isolation."

rachel: follow-ups: @lee for infra isolation plan, @diego to add a regression test that simulates mixed-region cache pressure, @ops to update customers if INC severity escalates.

ops: noting timeline and stakeholders in the incident. Close the canary tracking ticket for now; we'll re-open when isolation is in place.

rachel: thanks team. We'll resume wider rollout after infra remediation and a retest. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
